name: A10-0278/2026 – Nathalie Loiseau – § 10 – Am 10
title: REPORT on EU-Syria political relations
part_text: 10. Recognises Israel’s legitimate security concerns regarding terrorist organisations and Iranian-backed militias operating from Syrian territory, and its right to defend its population; welcomes ongoing diplomatic efforts towards a security agreement between Israel and Syria aimed at reaching a mutually acceptable security agreement that addresses the security concerns of both countries and calls for the effective protection of the Druze and other communities under threat;
